title: NASA's stranded astronauts have finally returned to Earth after spend...
description: NASA's stranded astronauts have finally returned to Earth after spending nine months on the International Space Station (ISS). Sunita Williams and Butch Wilmore splashed down off the coast of Tallahassee, Florida at 5:57pm ET this evening. They were accompanied by the Crew-9 astronauts, NASA's Nick Hague and Russian cosmonaut Aleksandr Gorbunov. A recovery ship pulled the capsule out of the water and loaded it onto the deck. The four astronauts gradually emerged through the hatch and took their first breaths of fresh air in months. Read the full story on DailyMail.com. Link in bio.  #news #astronauts #nasa #spacex #space
